name: fresh_dev_v1
describes: A freshly created ClaudeDev on the dev world: no gear in any slot, all 12 skills at level 1 with 0 XP, no quests beyond the automatic tutorial start, no lodestones built (only the inactive Temple lodestone), spawn at the church start area.
open_questions: No reset verb exists yet: a used ClaudeDev is not fresh. Needs a new dev character per suite run, or a verified reset route (reset_skills / inventory clear).
Lodestone state and quest state must be read by the probe (quests: v2 reads QuestProgressComponent; lodestones: not yet).
Scene spawns (creatures 40 m off) are not grants; confirm on dev they do not aggro before he engages.
grant_policy: Luis 2026-10-26: main variants grant NO items; he obtains every prerequisite himself (his Director plans them). Grant-using setups belong only to *_quick cases (variant quick, never counted for GOAL).
